name: zeffect_anim_save_anim_records
description: zEffect_Anim::SaveAnimRecords serializes eligible animation entries into Anim#### ZAR sections with tracked Object3D node state.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x461430 starts at entry index 1, stops when the prior write result is zero, and skips the table when g_zEffectAnim_EntryCount <= 1.
It skips activationState 5 entries, skips entries with 0x1000 set unless 0x2000 is also set, and skips all writes when g_zEffectAnim_RecordQueueEnabled is zero.
For each saved entry it formats Anim%04d using entryIndex + g_zEffectAnim_ActivationRecordCount and writes a stack payload of 0x58 + trackedNodeCount * 0x44 bytes through zUtil_ZAR::WriteSectionBlob.

Tracked Object3D nodes record the validated node index, active flag, cached-matrix flag, and either the cached 12-float matrix or position/rotation/scale values; null or non-Object3D tracked nodes store nodeIndex -1.
known_limits: code/function tier S byte verification remains deferred to a coherent zEffect animation save/load source-cluster pass.
